items.label: Max Trailing Drawdown
items.detail: EOD trailing drawdown. 4% for $25K–$50K accounts. 3% for $100K–$150K accounts. Trails daily EOD balance. Locks at initial balance once 4% profit is reached.

items.label: Daily Loss Limit
items.detail: No explicit daily loss limit — trailing drawdown is the primary risk control.

items.label: Profit Target
items.detail: Single phase. 6% of initial balance. No minimum trading days required.

items.label: Consistency – Challenge
items.detail: Biggest winning day ÷ total profit ≤ 40% to pass. Example: $11,250 best day / $25,000 total = 45% → need $3,125 more.

items.label: Consistency – Funded
items.detail: For payout eligibility, biggest day must be ≤ 35% of total profit.

items.label: Risk Per Trade Idea
items.detail: Effective 7 Apr 2026 17:00 EST. For DX Futures: max 1% of initial balance. For Tradovate & NinjaTrader: max 2% of initial balance. Applies to Hola Prime (Funded) accounts only. Splitting a trade into multiple positions counts as 1 idea. A new position within 10 mins of closing in the same direction = 1 idea. Stop loss must be placed within 3 minutes of opening a position or prior to closing, whichever occurs earlier.

items.label: Inactivity Limit
items.detail: No activity (Sunday–Friday) = account closure. A traded day requires at least one fully completed round-trip trade.

items.label: News Trading
items.detail: No restriction on news hours in challenge or funded. Not recommended due to slippage risk.

items.label: Overnight Hold
items.detail: All trades must be closed before 3:30 PM CT (Mon–Fri). Risk team starts closing at 3:28 PM CT.

items.label: Weekend Hold
items.detail: All trades must be closed before 3:30 PM CT Friday. Auto-closed and account terminated if open. Cannot be reopened or reset.

items.label: Agricultural Contracts
items.detail: CBOT (Corn/Wheat/Soybeans): Mon–Fri 8:30 AM–1:20 PM CT. CME Cattle/Hogs: 8:30 AM–1:05 PM CT. Close before respective market hours.

sections.title: Maximum Exposure Limit (The highest total contracts permitted open at any moment across all instruments. e.g., Max 5 allows 3 ES long + 2 GC short simultaneously)

items.label: Profit Split
items.detail: Every 5 calendar days from first trade on funded account.

items.label: Winning Days Req.
items.detail: Must achieve 5 non-consecutive profitable days per payout cycle. Minimum daily profit per account size applies. Resets after each payout.

items.label: Consistency
items.detail: Best day must not exceed 35% of total profit at time of payout request.

sections.title: Min Daily Profit for Winning Day

items.label: Max Funded Accounts
items.detail: Whichever is reached first. 5 accounts of $25K each = cap reached. 2×$150K + 2×$100K = $500K cap reached.

items.label: Live Account
items.detail: Invitation only. Requires 10+ payouts and $50,000+ in rewards on funded account.

items.label: Merging
items.detail: Only 1-Step Prime Futures funded accounts can be merged together.

items.label: Tradable Instruments
items.detail: Equity Index, Currency, Energy, Agricultural, and Cryptocurrency Futures.
